vlogs are a new and unique social media platform for patients to share their stories and receive support from other patients.
health vlogs are a new and promising way to provide support for people with chronic illness, and HCI can play a key role in the design and development of future health vlogs.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
health vlogs provide an effective way to deliver social support for chronic illness management.
the vlogs provide a unique platform for social support and community-building for chronic illness management.

the unique video-based medium of vlogs allowed for a more intense and enriched disclosure of personal information to the viewers than typical text-based media, leading to a more intense and richer interaction between vloggers and the commenters.
The main takeaway from our work is that

vlogs can serve as an important medium for chronic illness patients to seek social support and build social networks, and the HCI community should take advantage of the unique communication structure and affordances of vlogs to further improve health outcomes.

HCI should consider the unique affordances of the video medium to design technologies that facilitate the formation of small ad hoc communities for health-related support and information sharing, and to provide social support to chronic illness patients.
HCI researchers should consider the unique characteristics of the video format in the design and evaluation of health-related technologies.
